proposed_capability: P03/P141/P124 scoped branch/PR reconciliation and actionable P04-style local-game handoff for depositing A-OK-Bloomer Vertical Garden in Household Inventory. Reuse merged ui_chrome catalog recipe and screen_atlas; no alternate controller, plan-only acceptance or assumption of a native game connection from GitHub. No code path for direct game input is introduced here.
player_save_control_impact: Documentation and regression tests only; no Sims input, no save/mod writes, no background watcher. Actual deposit requires a game-capable local agent, explicit disposable save permission, fresh exact-patch calibration, independent scene cues and a screen-control grant respecting human priority.
expected_outcome: A repo-owned, executable local-agent handoff that requires AOK search, confirmed A-OK-Bloomer selection, held-object state, Backspace deposit, and independent Household Inventory item verification; aligns with existing screen atlas and UI chrome. Historical 38-branch reconciliation classifies strictly-behind and diverged heads without deleting unique work.
negative_tests: No claim that GitHub CI proves game inventory success
No lot placement or personal Sim pocket destination
No blind retry or double purchase after ambiguous Backspace result
No applying candidate 1920x1080 coordinates on an unverified exact-game build
No player input competition, screen lock bypass, or idle period below 15 seconds
No close of issue #35 or BI-002 without real host/game proof
No prune/force reset of diverged branches solely on commit counts
rollback_path: Revert docs-only PR; already-merged UI chrome and screen atlas remain unchanged; branch refs and user saves preserved.
unresolved_unknowns: Current running game patch, target UI scale and client bounds require local observation
Whether Eco Lifestyle is installed and AOK catalog item is visible on the authorized disposable save requires local observation
Real inventory before/after and funds changes require game-host evidence
Diverged branch tree-equivalence and user local worktrees were not available to GitHub search alone
